Introduction. Ulve are aggressive creatures found in Mountains inside Frost Caves. Their appearance is distinctly werewolf-like, however unlike Fenrings, they trot on all-fours.

Bite. Crouches down before swinging up to bite the player (80 Slash damage). This extends 2.2 meters in a 25-degree horizontal arc and can be used every 5 seconds when within 1.5 meters of a player.

Slash. Steps back before lifting both paws to slash downward (70 Slash damage). It has a vertical hitbox that hits 2.5 meters out and spans 60 degrees. This has a 9-second cooldown and can be used within 3 meters of a player.

Notes. • Ulv is from Old Norse ulfr. The word is still used in both Norway and Denmark but became taboo in Sweden and replaced with varg.
